name: presentation-skill-pack
description: Turn rough notes into a polished, editable slide deck — exports to PowerPoint, Keynote, and Google Slides.

plugins.name: presentation-skill-pack
plugins.description: The presentation-generator skill (author decks as structured JSON, export to native PPTX/Keynote/Slides) plus deck-design-judge: a tiered deck scorecard with deterministic gates, a 10-dimension rubric, and an optional cross-vendor multi-model judge panel that emits shareable scorecard.json results.
